title: New York Retail Food Store License Sites
description: Governed official New York licensed retail-food-store snapshot with provisional license organizations, conditional physical sites, source geocodes, ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, and privacy controls.
coverage_claim: License rows in the official annual current Retail Food Stores snapshot. This is source-specific license evidence, not a complete grocery or business census and not independent proof of day-to-day operations.
identity_rule: Each unique six-digit source license number creates one provisional organization candidate. A complete numbered physical street address additionally creates one provisional site and establishment; no parent, chain, or cross-source organization merge is inferred.
